name: Baked Cod with Peppers, Olives, Capers & Lemony Pine Nut-Arugula Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are charred in spots, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve olives lengthwise. Place in a small bowl along with capers and vinegar; stir to combine and set aside until the peppers are ready.
When the peppers are charred, remove from oven. Reduce temperature to 400°F.
Spoon olive mixture over the peppers and stir to combine; spread back out in an even layer.
Pat the cod dry with paper towels and arrange on top of the peppers. Drizzle with additional oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Return baking sheet to the oven and bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice one of the lemons into a medium bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with additional oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Add arugula and pine nuts to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to combine. Set aside.
Using a peeler, shave the Parmesan into curls. Set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the fish is done, remove from oven and top with parsley.
Divide peppers, fish, and salad between plates. Top the salad with Parmesan and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the fish. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
